# Synthetic media fixtures

Generated locally by `tests/generate-media-fixtures.mjs` using Chrome Canvas and MediaRecorder. No camera, microphone, user photograph or external download is used. Images are 160×120 red/blue panels with a green square; videos move the green square across 18 frames. PNG/JPEG and WebM/MP4 fixtures exercise real decoding, inline playback, source-byte retention and backup roundtrips.
